challenge.better_approach: Changing _ask_once to treat a scratch HOME as proof context was the alternative; it widens a gate shared by every caller (17d570c10390's design) to fix one proof's env. Passing the tester's id through the proof's own child env is the smallest fix and stays inside skill_block.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is the only variable the child needs to choose the scratch path. Measured: with it copied, all 34 teeth green on Linux.
challenge.prior_art: 17d570c10390 (850d9d327) introduced the PROOF_ENV gate in _ask_once; 0c2c3f53c2be moved judges into CodeMother's process. No ticket covers child envs that drop PROOF_ENV. Grepped CairnCommons/tickets for _WIN_ENV and CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID in skill_block: none.
challenge.real_collision: None. The minimal env exists so Windows children do not inherit a huge env; adding one named key keeps that aim.

answers.falsifier: Under bin/cairn test all 34 teeth of test_skill_block are green and none reaches /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0/bus.sock; with the env line removed the same 3 teeth red. Wrong intent if the 3 reds come from skill_block's own code rather than the child env.
answers.from_idea: none, because the trigger is a measured red, not a captured idea: cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/test_skill_block.py at d41cdc76c reds 3 of 34 teeth under bin/cairn test
answers.how: The proof builds a minimal env for its CLI children (_WIN_ENV). It drops PROOF_ENV, so transitions._ask_once falls through to reach('codemother') on the live bus, whose bus.sock is a dead file inside the seal. Rename _WIN_ENV to _CHILD_ENV and copy CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID into it when the tester set it. Red-first: the 3 teeth red on d41cdc76c, green after.
answers.traces_to: Law 8: a proof measures only its own component and never the live world; Law 7: a red the code did not earn is a false record.
answers.what: test_skill_block's CLI children carry the tester's CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID, so under the tester they ask a scratch CodeMother and never dial the live bus from inside the instance seal.

bullets.text: A proof that builds a minimal child env silently drops PROOF_ENV, and since 17d570c10390 that routes the child's judge asks to the live bus: inside the tester's seal they fail with ConnectionRefusedError after 15s.

title: test_skill_block's CLI children carry the tester's CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID, so under the tester they ask a scratch CodeMoth
